channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Asia, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 31 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 31 Aug 2026 (31 Aug to 06 Sep 2026).

  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 18 May 2026 (18 May to 24 May 2026).

  • CBPS Research Fellowship 2026-27 (Bengaluru)
    Centre for Budget and Policy Studies (CBPS) · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · INR 25,000 per month stipend, plus access to office space, internet and the CBPS library. The fellowship does NOT cover housing, transportation or any other financial support. No application fee.
    https://cbps.in/
  • Berggruen Institute: Peking University Research Center Fellowship 2026-2027 (Beijing)
    Berggruen Institute China Center, Peking University · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · 200,000 CNY annual stipend, paid monthly before tax. Fellows are responsible for their own income tax. No application fee.
    https://berggruen.org/news/call-for-application-bic-fellowship-26-27

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 11 May 2026 (11 May to 17 May 2026).

  • Taiwan AID: 2026 NGO Fellowship Program (Asia and Pacific Islands)
    Taiwan Alliance in International Development (Taiwan AID) · deadline Closed 01 Jun 2026 · Fully funded: round-trip airfare, accommodation (dormitory-style rooms, 6-8 beds per room), meals, and local transportation in Taiwan are all covered. NO artist fee, stipend or honorarium.
    https://www.taiwanaid.org/en/news/50124
